name: Sify Chennai 02 Siruseri hyperscale campus
notes: Sify's own pages describe Chennai 02 at Siruseri as an AI-ready hyperscale campus with 25.92 MW IT power currently marketed, while another Sify regional page says the Siruseri campus roadmap/development phase targets 130+ MW total IT capacity across three towers.

name: Equinix CN1 Chennai IBX, Siruseri
notes: Equinix announced opening of its first Chennai IBX data center, CN1, on 2025-09-19. The Equinix CN1 location page places it at Plot H12, SIPCOT Industrial Park, Siruseri, Chengalpet District, and lists 129,167 sq ft of space. Capacity in MW was not stated on the official page.

name: STT Chennai 7, Siruseri campus
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India
notes: STT GDC's 2026 Chennai 7 factsheet lists the facility in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with 7.2 MW phase-one IT load. STT's newsletter and release describe Chennai 7 as part of the Siruseri expansion and a broader Chennai multi-campus program.

name: Yotta Chennai Data Center Park, Singaperumal-Oragadam highway
notes: Yotta announced an MoU with the Government of Tamil Nadu to build a data center park on a 13-acre campus at Hiranandani Parks on the Singaperumal-Oragadam highway, with four data center buildings, 20,000 racks and approximately 150-240 MW total power load. Because the site lies in the Chennai suburban corridor around Singaperumal Koil/Oragadam, it is assigned to Chengalpattu district for this batch; later public build status was not confirmed.

name: AdaniConneX Chennai 1 data center campus
notes: Adani Enterprises' FY2025 data-center page says flagship Chennai 1 is live, with 17 MW IT load in phase 1 scaling to 33 MW. A 2024 Adani release says the renewable-powered, network-neutral Chennai facility near SIPCOT IT Park will be raised from 33 MW to 200 MW with Rs 13,200 crore investment.

name: STT GDC Ambattur Chennai campus / Chennai 2-4 expansion
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India
notes: STT GDC's Chennai location page lists Chennai 1 and the Ambattur Chennai 2 facility, with Chennai 2 at about 25.5 MW IT load. A later STT release says 40 MW is already operational at Ambattur and that groundbreaking of STT Chennai 4 unlocks approximately 130 MW total development potential including existing operational capacity.

name: NTT Chennai 2 hyperscale data center campus, Ambattur
notes: NTT announced the launch of Chennai 2 on 2023-06-29. Official NTT pages place the campus at Ambattur and list 34.8 MW critical IT load across buildings A and B, with 5,000 racks total.

name: Digital Connexion MAA10 Chennai campus, Ambattur
developer: Digital Connexion / Digital Realty / Brookfield / Reliance Industries
notes: Digital Realty announced launch of MAA10 in Chennai on 2024-01-12, describing a 10-acre Ambattur campus capable of up to 100 MW critical IT load. Digital Connexion's earlier release states the first phase offers 20 MW critical capacity.

name: CtrlS Chennai Datacenter Park
notes: CtrlS's own data-center footprint page lists the Chennai Datacenter Park with 1 million sq ft area and 72 MW IT load capacity. The services page breaks the park into Chennai DC buildings with 20 MW-class phases.

name: Iron Mountain Chennai data center campus, Ambattur
developer: Iron Mountain Data Centers / Web Werks-Iron Mountain JV
notes: Iron Mountain's official Chennai page says its Ambattur campus will provide 42 MW of power, with the first 23 MW expected at CHN-1 in 2026. DCD reported the campus topped out in 2026 and that the first building was expected to go live later that year.

name: CapitaLand Data Centre Chennai 1, Ambattur
notes: CapitaLand/CLINT pages describe Chennai 1 as under development on a 4-acre Ambattur site. The portfolio page and factsheet state 54 MW power capacity, 12 data halls and proximity to cable landing stations.

name: Princeton Digital Group CH1 Chennai campus
notes: PDG's India locations page lists Chennai CH1 as a 72 MW site planned as a three-building campus. Exact locality within the Chennai market was not confirmed in public source text reviewed, so this is assigned to Chennai at city-market level.

name: Sify Chennai 01, Tidel Park
notes: Sify's Chennai data-center page lists Chennai 01 in Tidel Park with 3.58 MW IT power; the Europe page gives the same facility as 3.6 MW. Tidel Park is in Chennai.

name: NTT Chennai 1 data center
notes: NTT's Chennai 1 official location page states 1,500 sq m of server space and 2 MW of IT load. It is treated separately from the newer Chennai 2 Ambattur campus.

name: ServerCake Coimbatore Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists ServerCake's Coimbatore facility at 41 Kamarajar Road, X Block, Coimbatore and describes colocation, cabinets, remote hands, bare metal and cloud services. ServerCake's LinkedIn page also says it has a datacenter in Coimbatore. Public MW capacity could not be verified from a primary source; aggregate capacity figures appear inconsistent and are not used.
